headline: Second big day running: cheaper clicks, richer leads, $11,915 NP
commentary:
### The day
- **$11,915 NP at 28.4% margin** — our best Tuesday in at least eight weeks.
  - NP: $11,915 v $6,514 last Tue
  - Best of previous eight Tuesdays: $7,766
- And we did it spending well under a normal Tuesday.
  - Cost: $30,078 v $42,072 eight-week average
  - NM%: 28.4% v 18.9% last Tue
- Two chunky days back to back puts November clear of October.
  - MTD NP: $26,691 v $19,943 same days Oct
  - MTD cost: $87,131 v $99,957
### What drove it
- Search did the lifting: more clicks, and each one cheaper.
  - Clicks: 2,296 v 1,962 last Tue
  - Search CPC: $10.43 v $10.85
  - generic spend: $4,671 v $3,347
- Lead value firmer too, helped by a strong run through the Test tree.
  - Search EPL: $31.23 v $28.26 last Tue
  - Test tree EPL: $24.42 v $19.25 last 7 days
- Evening was where the money sat, as usual on a good day.
  - 16:00 EPL: $46.39 on 78 leads
  - 22:00 EPL: $39.31
- Bing flat, PMAX back in the black on less spend.
  - Bing NP: $1,203 v $1,213 last Tue
  - PMAX NP: $320 v −$199
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 03/11 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SAs off, ROAS on | competitor, tROAS only | $703 | $735 | — |
| Speed | high target, walked down | $810 | $278 | — |
| Scavengers | cheap clicks, CPC capped | $1,615 | $1,253 | — |
- Speed spent nearly triple last Tuesday's, but clicks there are dear.
  - speed CPC: $18.00 v $14.65
- Scavengers still hoovering up clicks at around four dollars.
  - Scavenger clicks: 429 v 339 last Tue
### Monitoring
watch: Search EPL holding above $28 for a few more days is what turns this from a good Tuesday into a better lead mix.
Competitors are buying more share — lendingtree 20.3% v 14.4%, netcredit 41.7% v 36.2% — while our CPC fell, so whether cheap clicks last is the question.
Speed is spending more on a deliberately high target at an $18.00 CPC, so its lead value needs to justify that.
